visual.description: Two certification cards displayed as horizontal bars with properties. Bar 1: 'Oeko-Tex Standard 100' — bar shows '350+ substances tested' with Accent Pink fill. Bar 2: 'GOTS' — bar shows 'Raw material → Final product' with Accent Blue fill. Below bars: clean text card — 'Fewer finishes = Fewer chemicals' in Montserrat 36px, Warm Cream. Minimal closing advice. Dot-grid background.

notes: Practical takeaway scene — certifications viewers can actually look for. Horizontal bars work well for comparing scope/coverage. The closing 'fewer finishes' text is the simplest actionable advice. Crossfade into CTA section.
